gate.page: US Letter, 10 mm margin — a 196 x 259 mm content box, 740 x 979 px at 96 dpi
gate.rule: Cut content before shrinking type. Nothing substantive prints below 7.5 pt.

protected.what: a CITE THIS COHORT block on every prospect-facing artifact
